target.title: fix(tlon): bound urbit scry JSON response reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Tlon Urbit scry reads (`/~/scry...`) could cause out-of-memory failures when the configured ship endpoint returns an oversized JSON body on the success path.

Poke operations already bounded error bodies with `readResponseTextLimited`, but scry success responses still used unbounded `response.json()`, so a hostile or misbehaving Urbit HTTP endpoint could stream arbitrarily large JSON into memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the scry success-path `response.json()` call with the shared SDK helper `readProviderJsonResponse`, which caps reads at 16 MiB and cancels the upstream stream on overflow. The helper label retains the exact scry path so malformed or oversized endpoints remain diagnosable. This closes the asymmetric bound on the Urbit channel-ops surface and aligns scry with the existing provider response-limit contract.

Related focused PRs in the same plugin family: external image upload bounding (separate PR).

## User Impact

When Tlon scry reads ship state over HTTP, oversized JSON responses now fail fast with a bounded error instead of risking gateway/agent OOM. Normal small scry payloads behave unchanged.

## Evidence

Focused tests:

```text
pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.test.ts extensions/tlon/src/urbit/error-body-boundary.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
```

The focused channel-ops suite covers normal, malformed, and pull-streamed oversized responses. The HTTP boundary suite additionally exercises normal and oversized scries through the real `urbitFetch` request path against a loopback server.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Unbounded Urbit scry success JSON reads could OOM when the operator-configured ship endpoint streams an oversized body.
- **Real environment tested:** Node 24 hosted CI with real `Response` / `ReadableStream` bodies and a loopback HTTP server through the production `urbitFetch` + `readProviderJsonResponse` path.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.test.ts extensions/tlon/src/urbit/error-body-boundary.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
 ✓ parses successful scry JSON responses
 ✓ rejects malformed scry response JSON
 ✓ bounds oversized scry JSON responses
 ✓ parses a normal scry response over HTTP
 ✓ bounds a streaming successful scry response over HTTP

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Oversized scry JSON is rejected with `Tlon scry response for path /groups-ui/v6/init.json: JSON response exceeds 16777216 bytes`; valid small JSON still parses; malformed and oversized errors retain their exact scry path; the pull-driven stream is cancelled before its full fixture is read.
- **What was not tested:** Live scry against a production Urbit ship; no external account credentials were available. Loopback proof exercises the real Tlon HTTP request/read path.

## Tests and validation

- `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.test.ts extensions/tlon/src/urbit/error-body-boundary.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
- Exact-head CI: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28759317984
- Regression tests added/updated in `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.test.ts` and `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/error-body-boundary.test.ts`
- Fresh structured AutoReview of the fixup and full branch: clean, no actionable findings

## Risk checklist

- Did user-visible behavior change? Yes — oversized scry responses now error instead of attempting unbounded buffering.
- Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? No
- Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? Yes — remote scry response handling is now bounded on the success path.
- Highest-risk area: Tlon channel operations that scry Urbit paths over HTTP.
- Mitigation: Shared 16 MiB provider JSON cap; stream cancelled on overflow; poke error-path bounding unchanged.

## Related context

Related #97558 (broader extensions JSON bounding batch — this PR is a focused scry-only slice using `readProviderJsonResponse`).

## Current review state

- Next action: land after exact-head CI
- Bot comments addressed: preserved scry-path diagnostics and added real HTTP boundary proof

## AI-assisted disclosure

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor agent)
- [x] Human-run Real behavior proof from local setup
- [x] Maintainer AutoReview against current `main` (clean)
